<!--
Step 2 of the workflow: selection of the predictor variables.
Self-contained: the whole analysis (extraction of the candidate variables at the
occurrence points, correlation matrix, PCA and final decision) is computed when
knitting, with the functions of src/variable_selection_common.R (the same ones
used by src/02_variable_selection.R); only the PDF is saved.

Inputs : data/raster/present/<variable>_present.tif (26 layers, 01_present_layers.R)
         data/raster/future/bio10_<ssp>_2071-2100.tif (extrapolation of bio10, 03_future_layers.R)
         data/species-points.csv
Output : S1_variable_selection_supplementary.pdf, next to this file
Knit with the "Knit" button. The working directory is this folder
(results/supplementary/), so paths to the rest of the repository start with ../..
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
# kableExtra would load many extra LaTeX packages (tabu, multirow, wrapfig...) that
# must be installed in the LaTeX distribution; only the few packages needed by these
# tables are loaded (see header-includes in the YAML header above)
options(kableExtra.latex.load_packages = FALSE)
library(kableExtra)

PROJECT_ROOT <- "../.."   # this document is in results/supplementary/
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "src", "figure_common.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())   # palette, theme and species lists
```

```{r analysis}
# The analysis and the reasons of the final decision are defined in
# src/variable_selection_common.R, shared with src/02_variable_selection.R
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "src", "variable_selection_common.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())

candidates   <- load_candidate_values()
pca_data     <- candidates$data
value_matrix <- candidates$values
n_incomplete <- candidates$n_incomplete

cor_matrix  <- cor(value_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
pairs_table <- correlation_pairs(cor_matrix)
pca         <- prcomp(value_matrix, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)
decision    <- selection_decision(cor_matrix, pca, candidates$min_cells)

candidate_vars    <- VS_CANDIDATE_VARS
no_future_vars    <- VS_NO_FUTURE
```

# Methods notes

```{r methods-note, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "An expanded candidate set of %d variables was evaluated for inclusion in the ",
    "species distribution models: the standard BIO1-19 bioclimatic predictors, two ",
    "edaphic variables (pH, sand content), and five CHELSA-BIOCLIM+ variables ",
    "(Brun et al. 2022) addressing atmospheric moisture, cloud cover and frost: ",
    "near-surface relative humidity (hurs), vapour pressure deficit (vpd), cloud ",
    "area fraction (clt), climate moisture index (cmi) and frost change frequency ",
    "(fcf). hurs, vpd, clt and cmi are provided only for the period 1980-2018, ",
    "without future-scenario layers; they were evaluated to identify which of the ",
    "variables available for the future best represent them. ",
    "Variable selection combined four criteria: pairwise Pearson correlation among ",
    "all candidates (exclusion threshold |r| > 0.7), the structure of a Principal ",
    "Component Analysis (PCA) ordination of the same variables, ecological ",
    "interpretability for this species assemblage and, for the variables with ",
    "future layers, the extent to which their future values (2071-2100) fall outside ",
    "the present-day range of the study region, which would force the models to ",
    "extrapolate. Candidate variables were ",
    "extracted at all occurrence points (n = %s records, %d species). ",
    "Soil layers (SoilGrids 2.0, 0-5 cm): cells without a soil estimate (urban areas ",
    "and water bodies, coded as 0 in the source files) were set to missing and filled ",
    "with the mean of the neighbouring cells before resampling to the climate grid, so ",
    "that records in towns and on the coast keep a realistic soil value.\n\n"
  ),
  length(candidate_vars),
  format(nrow(pca_data), big.mark = ","),
  length(unique(pca_data$species))
))
if (n_incomplete > 0) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "%d records without a value in at least one variable (outside the region mask) were excluded.\n\n",
    n_incomplete
  ))
}
```

```{r pairs-note, results='asis'}

    "vpd, clt or cmi. These four variables have no future-scenario layers in",

```

# Principal Component Analysis

```{r pca-variance}
kable(round(summary(pca)$importance[, 1:5], 3),
      caption = "Variance explained by the first 5 principal components.") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down"))
```

```{r pca-loadings}
kable(round(pca$rotation[, 1:3], 3),
      caption = "Variable loadings on the first three principal components.") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down"))
```

```{r biplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=6, fig.align="center", out.width="95%", fig.cap="PCA biplot of the candidate variables at the occurrence points of native and invasive species. Thick arrows and bold labels: final predictors; dashed arrows: variables with no future-scenario layer."}
group <- group_factor(pca_data$species %in% species_label(NATIVE_SPECIES))

scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2])
scores$group <- group

explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

ARROW_TYPES <- c("Final predictor", "Other candidate", "No future layer")
arrow_scale <- max(abs(scores[, 1:2])) * 0.8
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2]) * arrow_scale
loadings$variable <- rownames(loadings)
loadings$type <- factor(
  ifelse(loadings$variable %in% decision$selected, ARROW_TYPES[1],
         ifelse(loadings$variable %in% no_future_vars, ARROW_TYPES[3], ARROW_TYPES[2])),
  levels = ARROW_TYPES)
loadings$face <- ifelse(loadings$type == ARROW_TYPES[1], "bold", "plain")

# Labels are repelled from each other when ggrepel is installed (many arrows overlap)
label_layer <- if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = variable, fontface = face),
    colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE / ggplot2::.pt * 0.75,
    segment.colour = "grey60", segment.size = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.15, min.segment.length = 0.2, seed = 1)
} else {
  geom_text(data = loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = variable, fontface = face),
            colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE / ggplot2::.pt * 0.75, vjust = -0.5)
}

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = group),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  stat_ellipse(data = scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = group), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2,
                   linetype = type, linewidth = type),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")), colour = "black") +
  label_layer +
  scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLOURS, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c("solid", "solid", "dashed"), ARROW_TYPES),
                        name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = setNames(c(0.9, 0.3, 0.3), ARROW_TYPES),
                         name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", explained[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", explained[2])) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2.5)),
         linetype = guide_legend(order = 2), linewidth = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme_fig() +
  theme(legend.box = "vertical")
```

# Final variable selection decision

```{r decision-intro, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  "The final predictor set retained for species distribution modelling is: **%s**.\n\n",
  paste(sub("^PH$", "pH", toupper(decision$selected)), collapse = ", ")
))
cat(sprintf("The reasons for including each of them and for excluding the remaining %d candidate variables are given below.\n\n",
            length(candidate_vars) - length(decision$selected)))
```

```{r decision-retained, results='asis'}
cat("## Reasons for the selected predictors\n\n")
for (v in names(decision$retained)) {
  cat(sprintf("**%s**: %s\n\n", v, decision$retained[[v]]))
}
```

```{r selected-correlations}
kable(cor_matrix[decision$selected, decision$selected],
      digits = 3,
      caption = "Pearson correlations among the final predictors at the occurrence points.") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped"))
```

```{r decision-table, results='asis'}
cat("## Reasons for excluding the other candidate variables\n\n")
for (v in names(decision$excluded)) {
  cat(sprintf("**%s**: %s\n\n", decision_label(v), decision$excluded[[v]]))
}
```
